findings.summary: The fp32 upcast runs after original_sd = model.state_dict() is captured, so with cpu_ram_efficient_loading rank 0 broadcasts bf16/fp16 tensors while other ranks allocate fp32 receive buffers, causing mismatched dtypes in dist.broadcast (garbage weights, NCCL error or hang).
The new tests all set cpu_ram_efficient_loading = False, so the broadcast dtype-mismatch path is not covered and the bug would go undetected.
